Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner correctly identified that Charles Armand René de La Trémoille was the son of Charles Louis Bretagne de La Trémoille in Step 11. However, the Planner made a critical logical error in the "Updated Understanding" section of that same step. The Planner stated: "Therefore, Charles Louis Bretagne de La Trémoille is the paternal grandfather of Charles Bretagne Marie De La Trémoille." This conclusion is incorrect because Charles Louis Bretagne de La Trémoille is the *great-grandfather* (grandfather's father), not the paternal grandfather. The paternal grandfather is Charles Armand René de La Trémoille (the father of Jean Bretagne Charles, who is the father of Charles Bretagne Marie). The Planner failed to trace the lineage correctly: Charles Bretagne Marie -> (Father) Jean Bretagne Charles -> (Father) Charles Armand René -> (Father) Charles Louis Bretagne. The Planner stopped one generation too short in the chain of reasoning, identifying the great-grandfather instead of the paternal grandfather.
